description: This file declares the interface for the ConfigFragment class within the cuttlefish namespace. It includes class declarations with virtual methods for obtaining the name, serializing, and deserializing configuration fragments, and includes necessary headers.

classes.name: ConfigFragment
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for configuration fragments, including methods for retrieving the name, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the configuration fragment.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the configuration fragment into a JSON value.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a JSON value into the configuration fragment.
